interface.longDescription: SaySo reads the iPhone screen you choose to share. With a SaySo accessory connected, it can tap, type and scroll for you. Stop tapping or end sharing in the SaySo app. SaySo 读取已共享的 iPhone 画面；连接 SaySo 配件后，可帮你点、输入和滚动。停止帮你点与结束共享可在 SaySo App 中完成。
interface.shortDescription: Read & tap / 读屏和帮你点
